class.name: Betacade
class.description: Reports game state, saves, and custom events to a Betacade play page from a Blazium Web export. Saves become progress and pinned metrics, [method event] becomes a custom event, and [method set_state] feeds replays. Off Betacade every call stays safe: a Betacade Web export still writes [code]localStorage[/code] and the other calls do nothing; on other platforms saves go to [code]user://betacade.cfg[/code]. The play page contract is Matt Connors' Betacade module and the public Betacade guide linked below.

method.name: achieve
method.description: Asks Betacade to check the saves for the achievement [param key] now. Call it after the [method save] that should earn it.

method.name: event
method.description: Records a custom event. [param name] uses letters, digits, and [code]_ . : -[/code], up to 40 characters. [param fields] has at most 16 keys, each a number, a bool, or a [String]. Track moments, not frames.

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the last host error, or an empty string. Betacade calls do not report an error when the play page is absent.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when this export is running on a Betacade play page.

method.name: is_on_host
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the Betacade export glue is loaded.

method.name: is_replaying
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the studio replay viewer is playing this game back.

method.name: load
method.description: Returns the value last saved under [param key], or [param default]. Values go through JSON, so numbers come back as [float].

method.name: save
method.description: Saves [param value] as JSON under [param key]. On a Betacade Web export this is [code]localStorage.setItem[/code]. Elsewhere it is [code]user://betacade.cfg[/code]. Save when something happens, up to about once a second, and keep each key under 256 KB. Keys that start with [code]secret:[/code] stay on the device.

method.name: set_state
method.description: Gives Betacade the latest game state for a smooth replay. Calling it every frame is fine: only the latest value is kept. If [signal replay_state] is connected before the first call, the game also registers for replays.

method.name: submit_score
method.description: Sends a score to the game's leaderboard when a run ends. Higher wins; send a time negated.

signal.name: paused
signal.description: The play page paused the game.

signal.name: replay_entered
signal.description: The studio replay viewer started playing this game back.

signal.name: replay_state
signal.description: In a replay: draw this [param state], one previously passed to [method set_state].

signal.name: result
signal.description: Emitted when a host call returns a payload.

signal.name: resumed
signal.description: The play page resumed the game.

signal.name: unavailable
signal.description: Emitted when a call cannot reach the host.
